your_games.title: 🌴 GTA VI is out now and is Metacritic's highest-rated game ever
your_games.body: Rockstar's game is unlocking at midnight local time around the world on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with Xbox One owners able to stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. Reviews landed yesterday and put it on a 99 Metascore from more than 150 critics, tying the original Ocarina of Time's 99 (which came from just 22 reviews) and topping Metacritic's all-time list. It's on 98 at OpenCritic. Critics praise Leonida's detail and Jason and Lucia's relationship, with the main gripes being a story that occasionally sags and some performance dips.

your_games.title: 🐌 GTA VI is locked to 30fps, and even the PS5 Pro won't get a 60fps mode
your_games.body: Rockstar's technology production director Marc Chambers says the PS5 Pro's processor is only slightly better than the base PS5's and isn't powerful enough to run the game's simulation at higher frame rates, so the Pro's extra muscle goes on ray-traced shadows and PSSR clarity instead. Digital Foundry found the Pro holds 30fps steadily, while the base PS5 sees more dips. The Series S version cuts back on detail and still drops frames.

your_games.title: 🎟️ Claiming GTA VI's free GTA+ month? It auto-renews
your_games.body: Every GTA VI pre-order comes with a free month of GTA+, but auto-renew is switched on, so you'll be charged $7.99/£6.99/€7.99 a month once it ends. On PS5, go to the PS Store, select '...' then Subscriptions, pick GTA+ and cancel; you keep the rest of the free month. PSN also wobbled for some as the game unlocked, because digital copies need to verify their licence; a console restart usually sorts it.

your_games.title: 🐉 RuneScape: Dragonwilds hotfix 1.0.2.2 fixes the Earth Magic armour bug
your_games.body: Jagex's hotfix makes Armour of the Earth actually reduce damage when you only have one stack, fixes audio dropping out, stops doors and windows opening halfway or swinging the wrong way, and stops the camera snapping into first person around Dowdun Reach. Dedicated servers need a restart to apply it. Auto-save stutter and Xbox-hosted worlds only letting one client join are still being investigated.

your_games.title: 🃏 Pokémon TCG Pocket's first Limited Battles event is live
your_games.body: Dual Fusion Limited Battles has you play a restricted format for booster packs and rewards, with missions offering eight promo cards, including Mega Mewtwo Y ex. Nine wins earns a Mega Mewtwo X playmat. It runs until 2 December.

your_games.title: 🏝️ Coral Island farms its way onto Switch 2 on 7 December
your_games.body: The cosy farming sim arrives with four-player multiplayer and cross-play. The free 1.4 Kids Grow Up update lands the same day on every platform, letting your children grow from babies to teenagers with their own hobbies, plus new cosmetics, Fishing Mastery bobbers and lighting improvements.

your_games.title: 🎮 8BitDo reveals its own GameCube-style controller for Switch 2
your_games.body: The GC Bluetooth Gamepad celebrates the GameCube's 25th anniversary, works with Switch, Switch 2 and Windows, and undercuts Nintendo's own GameCube pad. It's due on 10 December.

industry.title: GTA VI breaks the all-time livestream record before most of the world can play
industry.body: Streams Charts counted a combined peak of about 7.89 million concurrent viewers across Twitch, YouTube, Kick and others, far ahead of Valorant's 1.74 million beta record. On Twitch alone it hit 3.29 million, the platform's most-watched gaming category ever, passing League of Legends' 3.11 million.

industry.title: Console shipments fall 36.5% in Q3 as prices bite
industry.body: S&P Global Market Intelligence Kagan says 6.4 million consoles shipped in the quarter. Switch 2 fell from 5.5 million to 3.3 million after its launch rush, PlayStation dropped 35.3% to 2.6 million and Xbox 14.2% to 500,000. Analyst Neil Barbour says GTA VI and Ocarina of Time can only do so much when hardware costs more than many people will spend, though PS5 Pro has gained traction ahead of GTA VI.

industry.title: Take-Two shares jump on GTA VI's reviews
industry.body: Take-Two's stock rose 6.4% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the 99 Metascore. Oppenheimer expects about 20 million copies sold and more than $1.85 billion in revenue in the first three days, and Take-Two's first sales update could come as early as 20 November.

industry.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's lead writer has left Sandfall
industry.body: Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, who won a BAFTA Breakthrough award for the game's writing, says she left in July after wrapping up final work on Expedition 33 and wants to pursue her own projects and mentor new writers. Sandfall hasn't revealed its next game yet.

industry.title: MindsEye studio Build A Rocket Boy wants to sue alleged saboteurs to pay off £62m
industry.body: An administration filing repeats the studio's claim that a coordinated campaign of negative reviews hurt MindsEye, and says lawsuits against the third parties it blames could help repay creditors. It has asked investors for more money to fund the legal action.
